note: Unlike the Causal edge to the same node, this one is a derivation rather than a citation. CCv is CausalVisibility ∧ CausalArbitration ∧ RVal (Viotti & Vukolić 2016, Eq. 26), where CausalArbitration is hb ⊆ ar and hb = (so ∪ vis)+. WritesFollowReads is (vis; so|rd→wr) ⊆ ar (Eq. 25). Since vis ⊆ hb and so ⊆ hb, the composite vis;so|rd→wr lies in hb+ = hb ⊆ ar, so CCv satisfies WFR by construction. The converse fails — WFR constrains only write-after-read within a session and says nothing about visibility or the arbitration of anything else — so writes-follow-reads is strictly weaker.
